gold_conclusion_summary: Weight losses with liquid-formula diets (VLCD/LELD) are not significantly different between obese participants with and without T2DM (WMD=-1.2 kg, 95% CI: -4.1 to 1.6 kg) based on 5 studies (n=569).
corpus_matching_limitation: The official task row lists five included studies but exposes only three matched corpus IDs: 4565, 4566, and 4567. The two remaining included references are present as extracted/raw titles, not as matched corpus records in the accessible public row metadata.
